title: Goalllll
blurb: Held for as long as one set of lungs allows, this is the elongated goal call that Latin American broadcasting turned into a discipline. Length grades the moment. A routine tap-in earns a short one; a decisive strike gets an aria, and the commentator's stamina becomes part of the record. Spanish-language television carried the style to the rest of the world, and it long ago escaped football, turning up over exam results, job offers and successfully reversed trailers. No subtlety is available here and none is wanted. Fair warning that this clip runs much longer than most soundboard buttons.
origin: An extended 'goooool' call in the Latin American football commentary tradition.
